annotations.title: CSV to JSON with column profile

description: CSV to JSON with column profile — Parse CSV, TSV, semicolon or pipe-delimited text into JSON rows. Detects the delimiter, handles quoted fields, de-duplicates header names, infers column types (integer, number, boolean, date, string) and returns per-column profiles: nulls, distinct values, min, max, sum and mean. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_csv
